name: Community Conservation Grant
summary: Small grants for direct, community-led conservation of coral reefs, seagrass beds and mangroves in Southeast Asia, typically up to US$20,000 for first-time partners, open to individuals, community groups and NGOs with budgets under US$1 million.

amount.note: First-time grants; larger follow-on grants possible for strong partners

applicant_types.quote: Grants are available to individuals, community groups and registered NGOs across Southeast Asia, with priority for local organisations.

geography.quote: Grants are available to individuals, community groups and registered NGOs across Southeast Asia, with priority for local organisations.

access.quote: If you have any questions about the grant or would like to submit a proposal, please email us at grants@rumahfoundation.org.

amount.quote: First-time grants: Approved partners typically receive up to USD 20,000.
